content: Dart/Flutter Unix-socket client options: dart:io natively supports Unix domain sockets on Linux/macOS — Socket.connect(InternetAddress(path, type: InternetAddressType.unix), 0) — no plugin needed for a Flutter Linux client of dictad. On Windows, AF_UNIX in dart:io landed only in Dart 3.11 (still beta as of Dec 2025 SO report; reparse points, no datagrams/abstract/ancillary); the dart_ipc package (pure Dart, win32 FFI named pipes, socket-like API, young/low adoption) covers named pipes on Windows. Conclusion: keep the Dart socket client Linux-only; Windows uses FFI embedding instead. Sources: Dart SDK changelog, SO, pub.dev. HIGH confidence on dart:io Linux support; MEDIUM on Dart 3.11 Windows specifics.
